subject: Create prompt composer (src/engine/prompt.ts) + tests
description:
Create `src/engine/prompt.ts` with:
- `DEFAULT_TEMPLATE` — the full prompt template with `{scenario}` placeholder and guidelines
- `DEFAULT_PROMPT_CONFIG` — default PromptConfig using DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
- `composePrompt(scenario, config?)` — replaces `{scenario}` in template with describeScenario() output, appends extraContext if provided

Also create `tests/engine/prompt.test.ts` with tests from the plan:
- includes scenario description (evening/golden hour for hour 18)
- appends extra context when provided

Depends on: types.ts (Task #2), scenario.ts (Task #3)
